investment_description:
We specialize in the Medical Devices Industry, with employees who are experts in the health field. Product quality at affordable prices is our main advantage. Problems found in other companies will not exist in ours, as our investment strategy is a reliable solution for investors or distributors.

Brand ownership by distributors gives investors a long-term future in the medical device market. Product registration with the Ministry of Health is straightforward because we have all the necessary supporting documents.

Stock is always kept up to date to prevent expiry in your warehouse, as we produce according to order updates. We also provide direct delivery to customers to save costs and time.
how_we_make_it:
How We
Make It for You?
how_we_make_it_description: We offer products tailored to hospital needs. Competition is an important factor to consider, and ideas from Investors are applied as a form of two-way cooperation to produce high quality products.
note_description: "WE ARE KING" — Not only producing, but we also process everything until the product is well delivered to the customer. We also provide after-sales service to represent the good name of the Investor or Distributor. This system will not be found in any other medical device company in Indonesia.
hand_sanitizer_description: Available in liquid and gel form with various packaging: 5L, 500ml, 100ml. Using active ingredients such as Chlorhexidine and Benzalkonium.
hand_scrub_description: Special soap for medical purposes, containing Chlorhexidine, in various packaging: 5L, 500ml, 75ml.
disinfectant_description: Surface disinfectant with H2O2 active ingredient, suitable for surface disinfection needs. 5 Liter packaging.
detergent_description: Detergent for washing medical equipment, available in manual soaking and washing machine models, with Alkaline, Enzyme, and Rinse Aid types. Available in 5 Liter packaging.
alcohol_swab_description: Available in boxes of 100 pcs, with 2 Ply and 4 Ply specifications, using Isopropyl Alcohol and Ethyl with active ingredients such as Chlorhexidine.
bracket_500ml_description: Convenient 500ml bottle packaging for medical product dispensing in hospitals.
what_differentiates_us_description: Our products are created based on the problems and needs of hospitals — from users, hospital management, and ease of delivery and storage. The relationship between investors or distributors and customers will be represented by us with processes above the standard of medical device product services required by hospitals according to specified regulations.
hero_description: We deliver quality products at affordable prices, supporting health registration & fast distribution to grow your business.
profile_investment_body:
There are many reasons why you should choose us.

We produce products for your brand, building your company with quality products and excellent customer service.

With many product types in one business line, your promotions will be more effective.

Use this opportunity as a fast profit engine for your company.
profile_vision_body: To become an integrated medical device manufacturing company with healthcare institutions, creating high-quality products with continuous quality assurance.
profile_mission_1: Produce high-quality products with quality assurance as the top priority.
profile_mission_2: Develop innovative, eco-friendly products for healthcare practitioners.
profile_mission_3: Establish good production methods supported by technology to enhance company value.
profile_cooperation_body: Our factory operates in the medical device industry, specializing in antimicrobial medical liquids, managed by experienced Indonesian experts as our core strength.
profile_quality_1: Comply with applicable regulations from the Ministry of Health of the Republic of Indonesia.
profile_quality_2: Product quality testing at nationally accredited laboratory institutions.
profile_quality_3: Every product contains domestic ingredients to support the Ministry of Industry regulations of the Republic of Indonesia.
profile_req_1: We produce products with quality assurance and in compliance with production regulations from the Ministry of Industry and Ministry of Health of the Republic of Indonesia.
profile_req_2: Products are tested periodically, with production records reported directly through the Ministry of Health's online form.
profile_req_3: PT Komitkami Intinusa Gemilang is processing the Good Medical Device Manufacturing Practice (CPAKB) certificate.
step_medical_need_desc: High-quality product concepts and ideas we create to meet medical needs in hospitals.
step_lab_test_desc: Our products undergo periodic testing stages to ensure consistent quality.
step_registration_desc: Products are made with complete documentation to support registration and e-catalogue requirements.
step_tkdn_desc: The raw materials we use support achieving a high TKDN (Local Content) certificate.
step_development_desc: New products are continuously offered to stay competitive in the market.
